identity.scope: Historical Jerusalem; image shows the contemporary Old City, not a reconstruction.

introduction.en: Jerusalem is one of the world's oldest cities, with a history spanning over 5,000 years. Its origins trace back to around 3000 BCE, with the first settlement near the Gihon Spring.
introduction.fr: Jérusalem compte parmi les plus anciennes villes du monde, avec une histoire de plus de 5 000 ans. Ses origines remontent à environ 3000 avant notre ère, avec un premier établissement près de la source du Gihôn.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors · History of Jerusalem
source.changes: First two sentences excerpted; French translation by Bible contributors.
